digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: Live children declared `none` must be neutral in drift-scope inheritance: they contribute no paths and do not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance and prevents container classification as all-none; signed scope must fall back to unscoped when no parent or citation paths exist.

A container with all live children declared `none` must promote an undeclared parent to signed scope `none`; explicit parent `none` remains `none` and parent-owned paths take precedence over all-none children.
Mixed live paths and none children must sign only the path-child dependencies, survive unrelated file drift, and become stale when a declared child path changes.
Cheap resign in `resign.py` must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads, building the direct-child list from snapshot metadata and ticket states.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advising only live undeclared children as poisoners with both path declaration and `--none` as remedies.
